name: gakumas-adv-viewer
description: Standalone cross-platform browser-based ADV scene & character renderer and asset pipeline for Gakuen Idolmaster

scripts.build:wasm: rustc --edition 2021 --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -C opt-level=3 -C lto=fat -C codegen-units=1 -C strip=symbols --crate-type cdylib wasm/lib.rs -o web/wasm/gakumas_core.wasm
scripts.export:all: pnpm export:char && pnpm export:clips && pnpm export:env && pnpm export:bg && pnpm export:voices
